summary: Solitaire entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Solitaire
entries.definitive_edition: Classic Windows Solitaire for preservation; Microsoft Solitaire Collection for current access

emulation.emulator: Legacy Windows VM only for historical capture
emulation.notes: Use Microsoft Solitaire Collection for practical current route.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Classic Windows build with exact OS/app version and scoring/settings documented

primary.version: Microsoft Solitaire / classic Windows Klondike rules
primary.why: Microsoft Solitaire is the iconic Windows Klondike implementation. Classic Windows builds preserve the historical UI, while Microsoft Solitaire Collection is the current official route with modern modes, account features, and events.
primary.how_to_play: Use a classic Windows Solitaire build for historical capture or Microsoft Solitaire Collection for current access. Record OS/app version, draw-one/draw-three, scoring mode, timed/standard scoring, deck style, game number if available, and whether Microsoft Solitaire Collection events/account state were used.

secondary.exclusive_content: Current official Microsoft route with multiple solitaire variants
secondary.what_to_play: Use for practical current access and event/daily challenge documentation.
secondary.why: Classic Windows route preserves the historical Klondike UI and behavior.

entries.remaster_caveats: This entry tracks the Microsoft Windows Klondike lineage, not every solitaire game.
